blocks.text: A duelist's weapon — win fights one opponent at a time through precise single-target bursts and timed defense. Precision here is **timing**, not luck: no crits, no armor-piercing — just reading the fight and hitting the beat.

text: *The Sword is the trace left by **The One Who Answered** — the Unwritten who met every challenge alone, one at a time, and never lost the exchange. Every Sword skill is a fragment of how they fought.*

blocks.text: **Status:** the Sword's pool is complete — every skill is built and in the game. Numbers are still in tuning.

You learn these by practising the sword: each opens at the **Sword Mastery** level it names, and some need another skill first. A forged sword is also named for one of them — its **trademark** — and raises every number that skill puts out while you hold it (see *Weapons & Equipment*). Every Sword skill, with its numbers and effects, is listed in *Database ▸ Skills*.
Three, opening at Sword Mastery 30, 45 and 60. 40 MP, and a long cooldown rather than a charge meter.
No button, no mana, no cooldown — each one fires on a moment in the fight.

items: **Last Petal** — swing to build Rising Breeze, keep **Tailwind** running by staying on one target, then cash it all in one blow. Squall stacks it faster at the cost of a fragile window.

**Returning Wind** — Held Breath to bank the hits you were going to take, then release. **Howling Wind** stops them walking away from the bank; **Bare Branch** hands you more charges exactly when you're about to die. Squall's doubled incoming damage doubles the bank, turning its drawback into the payoff.

**Thousand Petals** — Squall first: attack speed buys more dance charges, more parries and a faster beat. **Second Bloom** keeps it going on every kill. The doubled damage taken is real — the Parry charges are your only cover.
